name: Bennie Taylor
bio: Starting out as a male model/singer Mr. Taylor slowly moved into on screen and voice acting..... Bennie had his TV/Film breakthrough in 2021 when he was awarded the part of Clive Bruneau in the Nickelodeon/Hulu TV-movie "California Dreaming" which led to a number of roles on television shows such as The CW's "Roswell New Mexico, Disney's "Single Drunk Female", NBC's "Primo", Sony's "Shadrach", NBC's "Pokerface", Paramount Plus "Mayor of Kingstown" MTV's TV-movie "Pretty Stoned", B.E.T's "Perimeter" and his big screen debut playing The Piano and Boulder Mover in WB's "Coyote vs Acme". Now the rest is history. Bennie has also worked as a producer in projects such as Mical Dark of the Knight and Batman Knightmare and The Bag Girls.

credits.title: Buddy
credits.overview: Inside the colorful world of "It's Buddy!", a group of children spend their days singing, dancing, and helping Buddy - bright orange unicorn - spread happiness. But when one child refuses to play along, Buddy is not pleased and cracks begin to appear in this seemingly perfect world.

credits.overview: The unique Bennett-Song family learns the true meaning of the holidays as they solve a community crisis and adapt to big changes. Everything you want in a holiday film: love, the power of belief, laughter, tears, and new musical classics.
